issues.reason: The standing half is that (Measure sk_shoot_1 score 64 stroke) puts a scale and a unit into the KB that no word of the sentence supplies, which *Core patterns* forbids ("point at the words that put the atom there"); the other half — that the object NP gets no witness — is the reviewer's own coverage gap, since a bare-numeral NP has no head noun to type and any class for it would be the same invention.

(MoreBy few sk_shoot_1 par 8 stroke) introduces the untyped constant par, which the text never mentions and which leaves an untyped referent symbol in the output, and substitutes the invented scale few for the surface word "under" that *Comparatives & degree* requires.

(MoreBy few howell kenny_perry 1 stroke) is ill-typed — the scale few is not a surface adjective of the sentence and is not predicable of a person — and its direction comes from golf world knowledge, which *Core patterns* bars from adding content; the "with"-PP also loses its attachment to the entering event.

gaps_confirmed: A bare-numeral NP naming a sports score with a relative-to-par modifier ("shot an 8-under 64"): no stated scale or unit for Measure, no class for the object witness, and no licensed carrier for "N-under".
A noun-headed measured advantage PP ("with a one-stroke lead over X").
A fronted free participial adjunct ("Buoyed by advice …, Howell shot …"): whether and how it attaches to the matrix clause.
new_gaps: A measured advantage noun ("a one-stroke lead") supplies no dimension word distinct from the noun itself, so Measure's scale slot has to reuse the head noun (lead).
repair_summary: Removed (Measure sk_shoot_1 score 64 stroke) — scale and unit are unstated — and (MoreBy few sk_shoot_1 par 8 stroke) — invented scale plus an untyped, unmentioned par — leaving "an 8-under 64" unencoded as a recorded gap rather than replacing it with an invention; replaced (MoreBy few howell kenny_perry 1 stroke) with the licensed surface-preposition encoding of the PP: a typed witness (Member sk_lead_1 lead), the event-side oblique (With sk_enter_1 sk_lead_1) reattaching it to the entering, the entity-attached (Over sk_lead_1 kenny_perry), and (Measure sk_lead_1 lead 1 stroke) for the stated one-stroke size.
notes: The reduced relative "advice imparted by Nicklaus", the by-phrase as Agent, the purpose infinitive (To sk_shoot_1 sk_enter_1) with a tenseless complement, and the bare deictic today all follow the instruction set; every defect was in the two numeric golf expressions.
